bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out review groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

Under supervision, validated pandas merges of product review records with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to a supervised course team, wrote Python functions for parsing provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

As an individual contribution to a supervised course team, ranked company report excerpts for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity in scikit-learn and checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.

As an individual contribution to a supervised course team, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks and used Matplotlib to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to a supervised research team, wrote Python functions for parsing provided policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Within a supervised research team, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out policy document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

As an individual contribution to a supervised research team, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
